review_rules: Distinguish Alessian, Reman, Septim and Fourth Era Imperial religious practice rather than treating the Imperial pantheon as static
Eight Divines and Nine Divines are historically contextual formulations; Talos-related doctrine must retain era and political context
Do not automatically merge Imperial gods with culturally corresponding deities; preserve syncretic identifications as sourced relationships
Religious commandments and temple doctrine are prescriptive evidence, not proof of universal practice
Talos worship after the White-Gold Concordat must distinguish legal status, public practice, private worship and regional enforcement
Cross-link existing Akatosh, Talos, Shezarr, Alessian Order, Temple of the One, Knights of the Nine, Amulet of Kings and White-Gold Concordat records
